- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned Rutherford Hill Winery for its panoramic views and renowned Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Frog's Leap Winery as an organic and sustainable winery offering a fun and educational experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended Castello di Amorosa as a castle winery with a medieval-inspired tasting experience, complete with a moat and a drawbridge.
